segments.title: Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official network countdown and sign-on; Case struggles with headphone hardware and wireless pack setup.

segments.title: Main News Desk
segments.notes: Case anchors with Pepito and Hype Train; covers US seizure of Russian/Venezuelan tankers, Venezuela political upheaval, AI-generated fake weather towns, Polymarket insider betting, raw meat addiction, world's smallest penis story, Olympic readiness, Tim Walz, and an ICE shooting in Minneapolis.

segments.title: Viewer Video Review
segments.notes: Case rates viewer submissions: ABC After School Special 'Stone', Magic: The Gathering Bogart musical by Jim Henson Co., pig sky-view fact, Joshua song, reborn doll pregnancy test, thick news anchor compilation, Alex Jones with Labubu, and Cucaracha remix.

segments.title: Park Interviews
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields callers from the bushes: Crum, AI Kevin Pereira, Lady Slightly in the Past, Skeletor, John Taffer, Dead Cream Team Spirit, Blank Man petitioner, Willy Wu Tang, Crack-a-Yogi Bear, Hamtaro acolyte, Marty from three bushes down, Cheese Puff presidential candidate, and AI Slop.

segments.title: Musical Outro
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs hillbilly EDM about JD Vance's survived break-in attempt, brings out a Vance impersonator for a 'solemn hillbilly instrumental' rap about his troubled mother, then closes with chat shoutouts.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Wednesday broadcast through technical difficulties, a chaotic Hype Train segment, and a grim ICE shooting report before closing with public domain cartoon news.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Delivered the cold open sign-on, revealed a baby intern, claimed to have undergone multiple puberties, and sparred with Case throughout the news desk.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Attempted a whale-fact rap instead of subscriber thanks, derailed into piss poetry, then quit the segment entirely.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: Infiltrated the studio as a wall-dwelling stowaway, brought wall energy that broke equipment, and threatened to summon Hate Sock.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Called into Trip on the Street claiming to be the real Leonard Crumb Fuchus Crumb, revealed wife Belulia and a cuckold dynamic.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: Closed the broadcast with a hillbilly EDM tribute to JD Vance's survived break-in attempt, featuring a Vance impersonator rapping about his fucked up mom.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito employs a baby as an intern.
Pepito claims to have gone through puberty multiple times yesterday.
Pepito references HAL as a voice-stealing power.
Crum's wife is named Belulia and their relationship involves cuckoldry.
Crum's full self-styled name is Leonard Crumb Fuchus Crumb.
Trip Bradstein shares a communal laundry puddle with neighbor Marty.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell's second 2026 broadcast careened from audio troubles through a whale-obsessed Hype Train meltdown, a Peter Gibbon intrusion, and a harrowing ICE shooting report before pivoting to AI-generated weather maps, raw meat addiction, and micro-penis discourse. The Amongst the Web segment descended into Jim Henson Bogart musicals and mental-break karaoke, while Trip Bradstein's park interviews attracted a parade of impostors including Crum, Skeletor, and a crack-addicted Yogi Bear. DJ Newsic closed with a hillbilly elegy for JD Vance's unharmed Cincinnati home.
